Every aiskills command, as it prints

Each aiskills command and what it prints, in color as on a terminal. Every command ran in a fresh home folder (shown as ~), against the same sample data as the examples in these docs.

  • skills CLIskills@{{SKILLS_CLI}}

Off shows the output as it reads when piped or with --no-color.
Built by npm run cli-outputs (src/scripts/docs/create-cli-outputs.mjs) from docs/cli-outputs/commands.json, with FORCE_COLOR=1. The npm registry data, download counts and npx skills find results are samples, and the stand-in npx skills prints nothing of its own, so only aiskills's own lines show for list, install and skills.
